text: This report provides information on property tax accounts with outstanding receivables of $500,000 or more as at December 31, 2018, and reports on the total outstanding tax receivables as at December 31, 2018. The number of properties with outstanding receivable balances of $500,000 or more is 21, as compared to 27 reported as at December 31, 2017.
The General Government and Licensing Committee received the report (March 15, 2019) from the Controller for information.
